C0684.title: Female Exam Candidate Bulk-Booked Hotels Near Test Centers and Resold Rooms at Markup
C0684.summary: In March 2026, a woman preparing for a public institution recruitment exam in Qixingguan District, Bijie, Guizhou, bulk-booked more than ten hotel rooms near exam sites through a lodging app to reduce travel and accommodation costs, then resold them to other candidates at a markup on social platforms. Police said the conduct disrupted the local hotel pricing system and normal market order, constituted disruption of public order, and was handled according to law.
